# Configuration reference

Every environment variable each component reads, with its default and
description. Descriptions come from the comment next to the code that reads
the option (Go components) or from the component's `.env.example`; edit them
there, not here.

## API (`apps/api`)

| Name | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `API_CACHE_TTL` | `30s` | no | CacheTTL is the lifetime of cached GET responses (API_CACHE_TTL, default 30s). Zero disables the response cache. |
| `API_REQUEST_TIMEOUT` | `30s` | no | RequestTimeout caps handling of every /api/v1 request except the SSE stream; past it the client gets a 503 (API_REQUEST_TIMEOUT, default 30s). |
| `API_REQUIRE_AUTH` | — | no | RequireAuth enforces authentication across all endpoints except health checks when set to true (API_REQUIRE_AUTH). |
| `API_STREAM_TIMEOUT` | `5m` | no | StreamTimeout bounds one SSE connection on /api/v1/stream/events (API_STREAM_TIMEOUT, default 5m). |
| `COLD_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID` | — | no | ColdStorageAccessKeyID and ColdStorageSecretAccessKey are optional explicit credentials. Empty falls back to the default AWS credential chain. |
| `COLD_STORAGE_BUCKET` | — | no | Cold storage (issue #146). Optional: an empty bucket disables the tier. |
| `COLD_STORAGE_ENDPOINT` | — | no | ColdStorageEndpoint overrides the S3 endpoint for MinIO, Backblaze B2, and other S3-compatible services. Empty uses the AWS endpoint. |
| `COLD_STORAGE_REGION` | `us-east-1` | no | ColdStorageRegion is the signing region for the archive bucket. |
| `COLD_STORAGE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` | — | no | Explicit credentials. Leave both empty to use the default AWS credential chain (environment, shared config, IAM role). |
| `COLD_STORAGE_THRESHOLD_DAYS` | `90` | no | Events older than this many days are exported to Parquet and deleted from Postgres by the nightly archive job. |
| `CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | — | no | corsMiddleware returns an http.Handler middleware that sets CORS headers. When CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS is unset or contains "*" all origins are allowed (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *). When it is a comma-separated list of origins, only requests whose Origin header is in the list receive an echoed origin back; all others receive the first entry in the list (the browser will still block the mismatch). This lets a self-hosted API restrict cross-origin access to the Vercel dashboard domain without any code change. |
| `DATABASE_URL` | — | yes | DatabaseURL is the pooled Postgres connection string used by the API. |
| `DB_MAX_CONNS` | `DefaultDBMaxConns` | no | API pgx pool limits and connection recycling. These defaults are suitable for a small deployment; set them lower or higher to match the Postgres capacity. |
| `DB_MAX_CONN_IDLE_TIME` | `DefaultDBMaxConnIdleTime` | no | API pgx pool limits and connection recycling. These defaults are suitable for a small deployment; set them lower or higher to match the Postgres capacity. |
| `DB_MAX_CONN_LIFETIME` | `DefaultDBMaxConnLifetime` | no | API pgx pool limits and connection recycling. These defaults are suitable for a small deployment; set them lower or higher to match the Postgres capacity. |
| `DB_MIN_CONNS` | `DefaultDBMinConns` | no | API pgx pool limits and connection recycling. These defaults are suitable for a small deployment; set them lower or higher to match the Postgres capacity. |
| `DIRECT_DATABASE_URL` | — | no | DirectDatabaseURL is the non-pooled connection string used for migrations. |
| `DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL` | — | no | Discord channel webhook URL that test messages and watchdog alerts are posted to. |
| `EVENTS_RETENTION_DAYS` | — | no | Retention window in days. Events older than this are moved from `events` to `events_archive` by the retention job (go run ./cmd/retention). |
| `GRAPHQL_COMPLEXITY_LIMIT` | — | no | GraphQLComplexityLimit caps the estimated cost of one /graphql request (GRAPHQL_COMPLEXITY_LIMIT, default 5000). |
| `GRAPHQL_PERSISTED_ONLY` | — | no | GraphQLPersistedOnly restricts /graphql to the embedded persisted queries (GRAPHQL_PERSISTED_ONLY). |
| `IDENTITY_SESSION_TTL` | `720h` | no | IdentitySessionTTL is how long a session token stays valid (IDENTITY_SESSION_TTL, default 720h). |
| `IDENTITY_SIGNING_KEY` | — | no | SessionSigner mints and verifies HMAC workspace session tokens (issue #518). Nil or keyless disables POST /api/v1/auth/session and session authentication. |
| `INDEXER_LEDGER_WINDOW` | `120960` | no | Number of past ledgers to include in a backfill window. 120960 ledgers at ~5s/ledger is approximately 7 days. |
| `INDEXER_MAX_DURATION` | `270s` | no | Maximum wall-clock time a single indexer run may take before forced exit. Set just under the cron interval (5m) so runs do not overlap. |
| `INDEXER_POLL_INTERVAL` | `5m` | no | How often the indexer polls for new ledger events (Go duration string). At 5-6 seconds per ledger, 5m gives roughly 50-60 ledgers per run. |
| `INITIAL_ADMIN_GITHUB_ID` | — | no | InitialAdminGitHubID, when set, seeds a user with the admin role on startup. The user is keyed by this value as both its ID and GitHub ID; an API key bound to that user ID (or an admin:* key) authenticates it. |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | `info` | no | LogLevel controls log verbosity: debug, info, warn, or error. |
| `METRICS_PORT` | — | no | MetricsPort, when non-empty, starts a second HTTP listener that serves only GET /metrics. It lets operators scrape metrics on a private interface instead of exposing the endpoint on the public API port. |
| `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` | — | no | OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is the OTLP/gRPC collector (host:port) that receives traces. Empty disables trace export. |
| `PORT` | `8080` | no | Port is the HTTP port the API listens on. |
| `REDIS_URL` | — | yes | RedisURL is the Redis connection string used for caching and advisory locks. |
| `REPORT_SIGNING_KEY` | — | no | ReportSigningKey signs exported SLA reports (issue #266). When empty the reporting handlers fall back to REPORT_SIGNING_KEY; with neither set the reports are emitted unsigned and every response says so. |
| `REQUEST_MAX_BODY_BYTES` | `strconv.FormatInt(DefaultRequestMaxBodyBytes, 10)` | no | MaxBodyBytesFromEnv resolves the request body size limit from REQUEST_MAX_BODY_BYTES, falling back to DefaultRequestMaxBodyBytes when the variable is unset. The value must be a positive integer: a non-numeric or non-positive value is rejected so a bad deployment fails fast instead of silently disabling the guard. |
| `SENTRY_DSN` | — | no | SentryDSN is the Sentry project DSN. Error reporting is disabled entirely when this is empty. |
| `SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT` | `production` | no | SentryEnvironment tags reported events (e.g. production, staging). |
| `SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET` | — | no | SlackSigningSecret verifies Slack slash command requests (SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET). Empty disables the Slack command endpoint. |
| `SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL` | — | no | Slack incoming-webhook URL that test messages and watchdog alerts are posted to. |
| `SMTP_ADDR` | — | no | NewSMTPMailerFromEnv builds an SMTPMailer, or returns (nil, false) when SMTP_ADDR/SMTP_FROM are not set so the caller can skip sending in environments without mail configured. |
| `SMTP_FROM` | — | no | NewSMTPMailerFromEnv builds an SMTPMailer, or returns (nil, false) when SMTP_ADDR/SMTP_FROM are not set so the caller can skip sending in environments without mail configured. |
| `SMTP_PASS` | — | no | SMTP_PASS is the password for SMTP_USER. |
| `SMTP_USER` | — | no | SMTP_USER and SMTP_PASS enable PLAIN auth against SMTP_ADDR. Empty SMTP_USER sends without authentication. |
| `SOROBAN_RPC_URL` | `https://soroban-testnet.stellar.org` | no | SorobanRPCURL is the Soroban RPC endpoint to query on cache misses. |
| `STELLAR_NETWORK` | `testnet` | no | StellarNetwork is the network identifier: testnet, mainnet, or futurenet. |
| `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` | — | no | Telegram bot token from @BotFather, used to send test messages and watchdog alerts. |
| `TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID` | — | no | Telegram chat id the bot posts test messages and watchdog alerts to. |
| `TRUSTED_IDENTITY_PROXY_SECRET` | — | no | TrustedProxySecret enables identity headers signed by a reverse proxy. Empty disables that identity source. |
| `VERIFY_BUILD_COMMAND` | `stellar contract build` | no | VerifyBuildCommand is the deterministic build invocation used for contract source verification (issue #263), parsed from a space-separated string. It is executed directly, never through a shell. |
| `VERIFY_TIMEOUT` | `10m` | no | VERIFY_TIMEOUT bounds a single contract verification build (Go duration). |
| `VERIFY_WORKSPACE_DIR` | — | no | VerifyWorkspaceDir is the parent directory for verification workspaces. Empty means the OS temporary directory. |

## Indexer (`services/indexer`)

| Name | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DATABASE_URL` | — | no | Postgres: the same schema the API reads (issue #500). A missing or unreachable database stops the indexer at startup. |
| `HUBBLE_BILLING_PROJECT` | — | no | Import mode: Google Cloud project BigQuery bills queries to |
| `HUBBLE_DATASET` | — | no | Import mode: Hubble events dataset to read (default crypto_stellar, mainnet only). |
| `HUBBLE_MAX_BYTES_BILLED` | `int(history.DefaultMaxBytesBilled)` | no | Import mode: largest scan one BigQuery query may bill; BigQuery refuses a query over it. |
| `HUBBLE_PROJECT` | — | no | Import mode: Google Cloud project that holds the Hubble events dataset (default crypto-stellar). |
| `INDEXER_ANOMALY_ENABLED` | `false` | no | AnomalyEnabled turns the per-pass anomaly detection job on (default off; issue #136). Indexer main.go wires it via env. |
| `INDEXER_ANOMALY_LOOKBACK_HOURS` | `168` | no | AnomalyLookbackHours is the rolling baseline window, default 168 (7 days). |
| `INDEXER_ANOMALY_MIN_HISTORY` | `12` | no | AnomalyMinHistory is the minimum samples before detection starts. |
| `INDEXER_ANOMALY_SIGMA` | `3` | no | AnomalySigma is the standard-deviation threshold, default 3. |
| `INDEXER_BACKFILL_WINDOW` | `int(poller.DefaultBackfillWindow)` | no | Ledgers scanned per step of a new contract's backfill. Progress is saved after every step, so a restarted indexer resumes where it stopped. |
| `INDEXER_CONCURRENCY` | `envInt("INDEXER_WORKERS", runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0))` | no | INDEXER_CONCURRENCY (or the older INDEXER_WORKERS) is how many contracts one pass indexes concurrently; defaults to the number of usable CPUs. |
| `INDEXER_FN_CALL_FALLBACK` | `true` | no | On by default; set INDEXER_FN_CALL_FALLBACK=false to only trust diagnostic events for function names (issue #504). |
| `INDEXER_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL` | `coordinator.DefaultHeartbeatInterval` | no | HeartbeatInterval is how often a worker reports liveness. |
| `INDEXER_METRICS_ADDR` | `:9100` | no | Address for the Prometheus /metrics HTTP server (empty disables it) |
| `INDEXER_REBALANCE_INTERVAL` | `coordinator.DefaultRebalanceInterval` | no | RebalanceInterval is how often the leader reconciles ownership. |
| `INDEXER_ROLE` | `all` | no | Sharded topology (issue #272). The default role preserves the original single-process behaviour: index every contract in this process. |
| `INDEXER_SHARD_COUNT` | `coordinator.DefaultShardCount` | no | Number of shards contracts are spread across |
| `INDEXER_SHARD_STORE` | — | no | Shard store backend: postgres (shared) or memory (single node only) |
| `INDEXER_WORKERS` | `runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0)` | no | INDEXER_CONCURRENCY (or the older INDEXER_WORKERS) is how many contracts one pass indexes concurrently; defaults to the number of usable CPUs. |
| `INDEXER_WORKER_ID` | — | no | Unique id for this process (required for coordinator and worker roles) |
| `INDEXER_WORKER_STALE_AFTER` | `coordinator.DefaultStaleAfter` | no | StaleAfter is how long a worker may go unheard before its shards move. |
| `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` | — | no | OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is the OTLP/gRPC collector (host:port) that receives traces. Empty disables trace export. |
| `SENTRY_DSN` | — | no | Error reporting is disabled entirely when SENTRY_DSN is unset: sentry-go falls back to a no-op transport, so reportPanic below still runs safely but delivers nothing. |
| `SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT` | `production` | no | Tags reported Sentry events with the deployment environment. |
| `SOROBAN_NETWORK` | — | no | SOROBAN_NETWORK is the network the call-graph backfill stamps on the rows it writes (testnet, mainnet or futurenet); defaults to testnet. |
| `SOROBAN_RPC_MAX_RETRIES` | — | no | buildRPCClients builds one Soroban RPC client per configured network. - SOROBAN_RPC_URL_TESTNET / _MAINNET / _FUTURENET point a network at its own node. - SOROBAN_RPC_URL is the default client, keyed by "", that the poller falls back to for contracts on a network without a dedicated URL. - SOROBAN_RPC_TIMEOUT (Go duration, default 30s) bounds each request and SOROBAN_RPC_MAX_RETRIES (default 3) bounds retries of HTTP 429/5xx and transport failures. At least one URL must be set: indexing without a node can only fail, so the indexer refuses to start rather than run passes that do nothing. |
| `SOROBAN_RPC_RATE_LIMIT` | — | no | Soroban RPC rate limit (requests per second). Optional, shared across workers. |
| `SOROBAN_RPC_TIMEOUT` | — | no | buildRPCClients builds one Soroban RPC client per configured network. - SOROBAN_RPC_URL_TESTNET / _MAINNET / _FUTURENET point a network at its own node. - SOROBAN_RPC_URL is the default client, keyed by "", that the poller falls back to for contracts on a network without a dedicated URL. - SOROBAN_RPC_TIMEOUT (Go duration, default 30s) bounds each request and SOROBAN_RPC_MAX_RETRIES (default 3) bounds retries of HTTP 429/5xx and transport failures. At least one URL must be set: indexing without a node can only fail, so the indexer refuses to start rather than run passes that do nothing. |
| `SOROBAN_RPC_URL` | — | no | Soroban RPC endpoint (defaults to $SOROBAN_RPC_URL) |
| `WATCHDOG_CONTRACT_ID` | — | no | Deployed sorolens-watchdog Soroban contract id (56-char, starts with C). After running contracts/watchdog/scripts/deploy-testnet.sh, take the id it prints and set it here so the indexer knows which contract's events to treat as watchdog telemetry rather than generic contract events. |
| `WATCHDOG_ENABLED` | — | no | WATCHDOG_ENABLED set to "true" makes the indexer record watchdog heartbeats for WATCHDOG_CONTRACT_ID while it polls. |

## CLI (`cli`)

| Name | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `COLUMNS` | — | no | resolveWidth uses --width when set, then $COLUMNS, then a 100-column default. |
| `NO_COLOR` | — | no | IsColorEnabled returns true when color output should be rendered. Color is disabled when NO_COLOR is set (any value) or when stdout is not a terminal. |
| `SOROLENS_API_KEY` | — | no | API key for authenticating with the Sorolens API |
| `SOROLENS_API_URL` | — | no | APIURL is only used for display in the header. |
| `SOROLENS_NETWORK` | — | no | SOROLENS_NETWORK is the default network for commands when --network is not given and the config file sets none; defaults to testnet. |
| `SOROLENS_OUTPUT` | — | no | SOROLENS_OUTPUT is the default output format when --output is not given. |
| `SOROLENS_OUTPUT_FORMAT` | — | no | SOROLENS_OUTPUT_FORMAT is a legacy alias of SOROLENS_OUTPUT. |
| `SOROLENS_PROFILE` | — | no | SOROLENS_PROFILE is the profile used when --profile is not given; it overrides the config file's default profile. A profile overrides the legacy top-level api_url and network values. |
| `SOROLENS_WATCHDOG_CONTRACT_ID` | — | no | SOROLENS_WATCHDOG_CONTRACT_ID is the watchdog contract `watchdog register` targets when --watchdog-contract-id is not given. |
| `SOROLENS_WATCHDOG_SECRET` | — | no | SOROLENS_WATCHDOG_SECRET is the secret key of the source account that signs `watchdog register` transactions when neither --secret-key nor --source-account is given. |
| `WATCHDOG_CONTRACT_ID` | — | no | Deployed sorolens-watchdog Soroban contract id (56-char, starts with C). After running contracts/watchdog/scripts/deploy-testnet.sh, take the id it prints and set it here so the indexer knows which contract's events to treat as watchdog telemetry rather than generic contract events. |

| `API_CACHE_TTL` | `30s` | no | Lifetime of cached API responses for GET /contracts, /contracts/:id and /watchdog/stats (Go duration). Writes to contracts purge the cache immediately. Set to 0 to disable response caching. |
| `API_REQUEST_TIMEOUT` | `30s` | no | Cap on handling one /api/v1 request (Go duration). Past it the request context is cancelled and the client gets a 503 TIMEOUT error. |
| `API_REQUIRE_AUTH` | `false` | no | Require authentication mode: rejects all unauthenticated requests except health endpoints. Defaults to false (open read surface). |

| `COLD_STORAGE_BUCKET` | `sorolens-archive` | no | S3-compatible bucket that holds archived events as Parquet files. Leaving this empty disables the cold-storage tier: the nightly archive job refuses to run and the API never falls back to object storage. Local development and integration tests use the MinIO service in docker-compose.yml: docker compose exec minio mc mb --ignore-existing local/sorolens-archive |

| `DB_MAX_CONNS` | `20` | no | API pgx pool limits and connection recycling. These defaults are suitable for a small deployment; set them lower or higher to match the Postgres capacity. |
| `DB_MAX_CONN_IDLE_TIME` | `30m` | no | API pgx pool limits and connection recycling. These defaults are suitable for a small deployment; set them lower or higher to match the Postgres capacity. |
| `DB_MAX_CONN_LIFETIME` | `1h` | no | API pgx pool limits and connection recycling. These defaults are suitable for a small deployment; set them lower or higher to match the Postgres capacity. |

| `INDEXER_LEDGER_WINDOW` | `120960` | no | Number of past ledgers to include in a backfill window. 120960 ledgers at ~5s/ledger is approximately 7 days. |

| `VAPID_SUBJECT` | `mailto:admin@sorolens.dev` | no | VAPID keys for Web Push notifications.  Server-side only; never prefix with NEXT_PUBLIC_.  Generate once with: node -e "const wp=require('web-push'); console.log(wp.generateVAPIDKeys())" or: npx web-push generate-vapid-keys A mailto: or https: URI for the VAPID JWT "sub" field. |
| `WATCHDOG_CONTRACT_ID` | `CACXRL67WL5KRD6HKWGYADHEUF6RQOCODUN26UQE7MGFZEMIR7PAX6R7` | no | Deployed sorolens-watchdog Soroban contract id (56-char, starts with C). After running contracts/watchdog/scripts/deploy-testnet.sh, take the id it prints and set it here so the indexer knows which contract's events to treat as watchdog telemetry rather than generic contract events. |

## Web dashboard (`apps/web`)

| Name | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `API_PORT` | `8080` | no | Port of the backend API server used by Playwright during E2E test runs (pnpm test:e2e). Exposed to browser: No (test runner only) |
| `API_URL` | `http://localhost:8080 (or NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL)` | no | Server-side API endpoint override/fallback. Used by server-side data fetching routines (e.g. server components). Falls back to NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL if unset. Exposed to browser: No (server-only) |
| `INDEXER_METRICS_URL` | `http://localhost:9100/metrics` | no | Prometheus /metrics endpoint of the indexer service. Scraped server-side by the /api/status/indexer route handler to display sync lag and ledger progress. Exposed to browser: No (server-only) |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` | `http://localhost:8080` | no | Public base URL of the SoroLens REST API backend. Exposed to browser: Yes (NEXT_PUBLIC_*) |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` | `https://sorolens.dev` | no | Canonical public origin of the web application. The single source for every absolute URL the dashboard publishes: metadataBase (social cards and absolute metadata URLs), robots.txt (host and sitemap URL) and sitemap.xml entries. Read by lib/siteUrl.ts; a trailing slash is stripped. Exposed to browser: Yes (NEXT_PUBLIC_*) |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_INDEXER_METRICS_URL` | `http://localhost:9100/metrics` | no | Public fallback alias for the indexer Prometheus /metrics endpoint. Used by /api/status/indexer if INDEXER_METRICS_URL is unset. Exposed to browser: Yes (NEXT_PUBLIC_*) |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_PLAUSIBLE_DOMAIN` | `none (analytics disabled)` | no | Domain name for privacy-preserving Plausible Analytics (e.g. sorolens.dev). Injected via a lightweight script only in production builds (NODE_ENV=production). Leave unset or empty to disable analytics. Exposed to browser: Yes (NEXT_PUBLIC_*) Example: sorolens.dev |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_PWA_ENABLED` | `false` | no | Enables Progressive Web App (PWA) service worker generation and registration in development mode when set to "true". In production (NODE_ENV=production), the service worker is always enabled unless explicitly disabled. Exposed to browser: Yes (NEXT_PUBLIC_*) |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN` | `none (reporting disabled)` | no | Sentry DSN for client-side frontend error reporting and performance tracing. Leave unset or empty to completely disable Sentry error reporting. Exposed to browser: Yes (NEXT_PUBLIC_*) Example: https://examplePublicKey@o0.ingest.sentry.io/0 |
| `PUSH_INTERNAL_SECRET` | `none (unauthenticated in development)` | no | Shared secret token guarding the internal PUT /api/push/subscribe endpoint (checked against the x-push-secret request header) for dispatching alerts. SERVER-ONLY SECRET: Must NEVER be committed to version control or exposed publicly. Set to a long random secret before enabling push notifications in production. Exposed to browser: No (server-only secret) Example: replace_with_a_secure_random_internal_secret |
| `VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY` | `none` | no | Base64url-encoded 32-byte EC P-256 private key for Web Push. Used on the server to sign Web Push payloads. SERVER-ONLY SECRET: Must NEVER be committed to version control or exposed publicly. Exposed to browser: No (server-only secret) Generate a keypair with: npx web-push generate-vapid-keys Example: fake_vapid_private_key_do_not_use_in_prod |
| `VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY` | `none` | no | Base64url-encoded 65-byte uncompressed EC P-256 public key for Web Push. Shared with browser clients via /api/push/key to subscribe to notifications. Exposed to browser: Yes (via /api/push/key API endpoint) Generate a keypair with: npx web-push generate-vapid-keys Example: BEl62iUYgUivxIkv69yViEuiBIa-Ib9-Skv6_example_public_key_only |
| `VAPID_SUBJECT` | `mailto:admin@sorolens.dev` | no | Contact URI (mailto: or https:) for the VAPID JWT 'sub' claim. Allows push services to contact the application operator. Exposed to browser: No (server-only) |

## Discord bot (`services/discord-bot`)

| Name | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `COMMAND_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE` | `10` | no | Per-user slash command budget, sliding 60s window. Default 10. |
| `CONTRIBUTOR_THRESHOLD` | `1` | no | Contributors need at least this many merged PRs against GITHUB_REPO. |
| `CORE_CONTRIBUTOR_THRESHOLD` | `3` | no | Contributors need at least this many merged PRs against GITHUB_REPO. |
| `DATABASE_PATH` | `/tmp/mappings.db` | no | SQLite database file. On Render's free tier there is no persistent disk, so we point this at /tmp (writable, but wiped on redeploy). Set the LITESTREAM_* variables below to back the file up so links survive redeploys; without them contributors must /link again. On a platform with a persistent disk (Render paid, Fly, a VPS), mount a volume and point this at a stable path like /data/mappings.db. |
| `DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN` | — | no | Bot token from https://discord.com/developers/applications/<app>/bot The bot also needs Server Members Intent and Message Content Intent turned on under Bot > Privileged Gateway Intents. |
| `DISCORD_CLIENT_ID` | — | no | Application id (also known as Client ID) from Discord dev portal. |
| `DISCORD_GUILD_ID` | — | no | Server (guild) id where the bot operates. In Discord: right-click server icon, Copy Server ID. Requires Developer Mode enabled in User Settings > Advanced. |
| `DISCORD_ROLE_CONTRIBUTOR_ID` | — | no | Role ids for the two tiers the bot auto-grants. Right-click each role and Copy Role ID. |
| `DISCORD_ROLE_CORE_CONTRIBUTOR_ID` | — | no | Role ids for the two tiers the bot auto-grants. Right-click each role and Copy Role ID. |
| `DISCORD_ROLE_VERIFIED_ID` | — | no | Optional. If set, /connect grants this role after successful OAuth link. Used to gate the community behind GitHub verification: hide most channels from @everyone, show them only to holders of this role. Discord's built-in Onboarding must be reconfigured to NOT auto-grant this role; the bot becomes the sole granter. |
| `GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID` | — | no | Create an OAuth App at https://github.com/settings/developers: Homepage URL           = value of PUBLIC_BASE_URL below Authorization callback = ${PUBLIC_BASE_URL}/oauth/callback |
| `GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET` | — | no | Create an OAuth App at https://github.com/settings/developers: Homepage URL           = value of PUBLIC_BASE_URL below Authorization callback = ${PUBLIC_BASE_URL}/oauth/callback |
| `GITHUB_REPO` | `sorolens/sorolens` | no | Repository the bot counts merged PRs against. |
| `GITHUB_TOKEN` | — | no | Fine-grained PAT for sorolens/sorolens, created on the account that should appear as the assigner. Needs `metadata: read`, `pull_requests: read` and, for issue self-assign, `issues: read and write`. |
| `GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | — | no | Shared secret you set on the GitHub webhook. Random 32+ char string. |
| `LITESTREAM_ACCESS_KEY_ID` | — | no | Optional backup of the database to S3-compatible storage (Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, AWS S3) via Litestream. Set LITESTREAM_BUCKET to enable. |
| `LITESTREAM_BUCKET` | — | no | Optional backup of the database to S3-compatible storage (Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, AWS S3) via Litestream. Set LITESTREAM_BUCKET to enable. |
| `LITESTREAM_ENDPOINT` | — | no | Optional backup of the database to S3-compatible storage (Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, AWS S3) via Litestream. Set LITESTREAM_BUCKET to enable. R2: https://<account-id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com ; leave empty for AWS S3. |
| `LITESTREAM_PATH` | `sorolens-discord-bot` | no | Optional backup of the database to S3-compatible storage (Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, AWS S3) via Litestream. Set LITESTREAM_BUCKET to enable. R2: https://<account-id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com ; leave empty for AWS S3. R2: auto ; AWS: your region, e.g. us-east-1. Folder inside the bucket (default: sorolens-discord-bot). |
| `LITESTREAM_REGION` | `auto` | no | Optional backup of the database to S3-compatible storage (Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, AWS S3) via Litestream. Set LITESTREAM_BUCKET to enable. R2: https://<account-id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com ; leave empty for AWS S3. R2: auto ; AWS: your region, e.g. us-east-1. |
| `LITESTREAM_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` | — | no | Optional backup of the database to S3-compatible storage (Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, AWS S3) via Litestream. Set LITESTREAM_BUCKET to enable. |
| `OAUTH_STATE_SECRET` | — | no | HMAC key that signs the short-lived OAuth state + the personal /oauth/start links the bot generates. Random 32+ char string. |
| `PORT` | `8080` | no | Port the webhook receiver listens on. Railway sets this automatically. |
| `PUBLIC_BASE_URL` | `https://sorolens.onrender.com` | no | Publicly reachable base URL of this bot. Used as the OAuth callback and inside /connect links. No trailing slash. |
| `SOROLENS_API_BASE_URL` | `http://localhost:8080` | no | Base URL of the Sorolens HTTP API. |
| `SOROLENS_API_KEY` | — | no | Optional. An API key with the `admin:*` scope, minted once from the dashboard or `POST /api/v1/api-keys`. When set, /connect mints a per-contributor key so each query command authenticates as that user. Leave empty to run the commands on the API's public read surface. |
